name: layout-v1
status: design, unvalidated: never built in Studio, played or measured on a device

conventions.units: studs, origin at the hub centre; x east, z south; rotation_y_deg as CFrame.Angles(0, rad, 0)
conventions.forest_frame: forest_world = forest_local + forest.offset; forest-layout-v1.json, islands-v1.json, relief-v1.json and hide-spots-v1.json stay in the forest local frame

stations.name: Corral
stations.holds: 8 pens where registered creatures idle and hover; prompt 'Ver corral'

stations.name: Refugio
stations.holds: registration hut: 'Registrar criatura', card, equip (the forest camp's refuge, duplicated)

stations.name: Cofre
stations.holds: storage chest: 'Guardar en el cofre' (extraction and banking)

stations.name: Puesto
stations.holds: reserved stall marker for the convenience-offer design; no purchase flow is built

stations.name: Tablero de Esencia
stations.holds: Esencia board: balance, what each corral creature earned, wave board top 3

stations.name: Árbol de habilidades
stations.holds: skill tree kiosk (Learn action) and upgrades (Upgrade action)

beast.name: Bestia de la Pradera (pending user decision)

west.dressing: evergreens thin to grass over 40 studs; fog density ramps from 0 at the hub wall to the forest value at the fog edge (x -135)

east.dressing: hub paving breaks into flower clumps and pale grass over 40 studs; warm light ramps up

beast_free_band.note: neither beast can hunt here: the hub, both transitions, the Pradera's west half and the whole ring road (outside both rectangles, so never a strike point)

zone_rules.region_of: x < -100: forest; -100..-60 and 60..100: transitions; |x| <= 60 inside the hub circle: hub; x > 100: pradera; |z| > 200: ring road

west.name: Claro del Umbral
west.note: new Safe-tier nest near the forest threshold; island 1 keeps its data

east.name: Prado de los Brotes
east.note: tutorial nest on the Pradera route, first node after the gate

streaming.note: with a 420 target radius a player at the hub streams the hub and both transitions, about a third of each region, never both beasts' grounds at once; measure on a phone before trusting any number
